title: Daddy's Car: a song composed with Artificial Intelligence - in the style of the Beatles
summary: Sony CSL's Daddy's Car is a pop song composed with AI in the style of the Beatles, with lead sheets generated by software from Beatles-style training material. Humans produced, arranged and performed it.
why: Cited as an early example of AI-composed music, usually with the caveat that humans did much of the production.

quote.text: The intent was to create a Beatles sound, and I think they did quite well.
